sat_alternator_tariff.desc: The mechanic says China is paying Trump’s tariff. China appears to be the name of your debit card.
sat_alternator_tariff.log_0: You get the supplies. China still hasn’t offered to split the bill.
sat_alternator_tariff.choice_1: Ask the mechanic to explain the invoice
sat_alternator_tariff.log_1: Parts, tariff, markup, freedom handling fee. Freedom is the only item with no return policy.
sat_alternator_tariff.log_2: You leave before the clerk tariffs the conversation.

sat_billion_pothole.desc: The DOGE-style board claims eight billion in savings. Someone checks the zeroes. The pothole asks whether anyone has checked for a shovel.
sat_billion_pothole.log_0: The savings shrink. The hole retains its original dimensions.
sat_billion_pothole.log_1: You fix the road. The efficiency dashboard takes the credit.
sat_billion_pothole.log_2: The pothole remains the most transparent part of the budget.

sat_cabinet_guest.desc: The checkpoint has adopted the administration’s Signal protocol: a secure chat, total confidence, and someone asking whether this is the book club.
sat_cabinet_guest.choice_0: Check everyone’s name before sharing the route
sat_cabinet_guest.log_0: The dentist’s patient leaves. National security improves without a software update.
sat_cabinet_guest.log_1: External Guest 4 reacts with a heart. Intelligence has never been so affirming.
sat_cabinet_guest.log_2: You leave the chat before being promoted to Secretary of Lunch.

sat_food_shelf.desc: The LFPA25 cancellation has inspired an agency sign: FOOD ACCESS STREAMLINED. Volunteers are streamlining potatoes into actual bags.
